title: sales-partnership-scratch-notes-nicole-kim
content:
Purpose: quick personal scratchpad for FinLedger & NimbusHealth partnership outreach + objection handling. Not official deck - notes to refine before handing to AE/SE.

High-level hypothesis
- FinLedger (mid-market fintech, HQ SF) is evaluating vendor-grade LLM inference to power: customer support summarization, KYC automation, and internal knowledge search.
- Pain: high per-token costs and unpredictable latency during peak batch processing (end-of-day reconciliations). Security team requires VPC and audit logs.
- Why Redwood might fit: dedicated capacity & private deployment options + cost controls (batching, quant profiles) and clear SLOs.

Key contacts (LinkedIn / company site)
- Priya Rao - Head of AI / FinLedger (priya@finledger.com) - signals: recently listed on engineering hiring page for ML infra.
- Marco Alvarez - CTO (marco@finledger.com) - cares about predictable throughput and regulatory controls.
- Sarah Bennett - Director of Ops (sarah.b@finledger.com) - will drive cost objections.

Account notes & signals
- Tech stack: AWS + some on-prem legacy for sensitive KYC docs. Likely needs hybrid (private + cloud).
- Recent funding: Series B (2025) - pushing product-market expansion, could be open to committed capacity deals.
- Competitor footprint: evaluating CloudAI X and self-hosted open-source stacks (Olivia mentioned they ran inference on Mistral locally for prototypes).

Estimates to surface (for discovery) - quick numbers to bring to initial call
- Current token volume (assumed): 250M tokens/month from support summarization + 50M from embeddings/search => 300M tokens.
- Rough cost delta (hosted vs dedicated): surface potential 30-50% savings on tokens with dedicated + batching/quantization. (TBD by infra/sequence length)
- Latency target: tail P95 < 300ms for small-gen use cases (support replies) - confirm SLA needs.

Outbound drafts
1) Cold email (first touch)
Subject: FinLedger + predictable, cheaper LLM inference?
Hi Priya - quick intro, Nicole from Redwood Inference. We help engineering teams reduce per-token cost and guarantee predictable latency for customer-facing LLMs while keeping sensitive data in VPC/private deployments.
Would you be open to a 20-min sync to share a couple of cost/latency wins we've seen with similar fintech stacks?
(PS - we recently helped a Series B payments company cut token cost 38% by combining prefix caching + dedicated pools)

2) Short follow-up (if no reply)
Hi Priya - looping back. Happy to send a short 1-page with: likely cost ranges, deployment options (private vs hosted), and a sample rollout plan (canary + fallback). Which would be most useful?

3) LinkedIn connection message
Hi Priya - Nicole from Redwood Inference. We work with fintechs on inference economics and SLOs. Would love to connect and share a short note on potential wins for FinLedger.

Call agenda (20 min)
- 3 min intros / context
- 5 min current infra & pain (cost, latency, compliance)
- 7 min quick sketch of Redwood approach (dedicated pools, private deployments, cost levers: batching/quant) + relevant case study
- 3 min next steps: technical deep-dive with SE or procurement intro

Discovery questions (prioritized)
- What are the top production LLM use cases today (support, KYC, search)? volume and avg seq lengths?
- Where is inference run today (hosted vendor, cloud endpoints, on-prem)? any compliance/VPC requirements?
- What are your current cost/leverage levers (batching, quantization, cache)? Any internal infra constraints?
- SLA requirements: p50/p95/p99 latency targets, throughput, maintenance windows?
- Are there internal procurement or data residency requirements that would push Private deployment?

Objection handling quick notes
- "Cost: we can self-host cheaper" => acknowledge: open-source + self-hosting can cut raw model costs but op-ex and ops complexity are often higher; highlight Redwood's Dedicated + Optimize recommendations (quant profiles, batching) and a predictable reserved capacity contract that lowers overall TCO. Offer a TCO calcsheet + 3-month pilot.
- "Security / data residency" => Redwood Private and VPC control plane, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs, on-prem option. Offer architecture diagram and an SOC2 discussion + customer references.
- "Vendor lock-in concerns" => emphasize model abstraction (can route to different model variants), pinning versions, exportable configs and clear rollback + canary policies.
- "We already use CloudAI X / other managed" => focus on measurable differences: token-level cost breakdown, per-route dashboards, explicit batching/cache savings, and seamless private/dedicated migration paths. Offer a short benchmark comparing their existing model endpoints vs Redwood on a small prompt set.

Materials to attach if requested
- 1-pager: dedicated vs hosted vs private (cost + security + use-cases)
- 2-page case study: payments co. (Saves 38% cost, P95 from 550ms -> 220ms)
- Sample SOW for a 12-week pilot (discovery, pilot cluster, integration, handover)

Internal next steps / TODOs
- [ ] Draft 1-pager tailored to FinLedger - include quick TCO table (Nicole) - due 2026-02-18
- [ ] Ask SE for short benchmark plan & cost model (Jordan)
- [ ] Identify customer reference in fintech (Priya)
- [ ] Prep basic architecture diagram for Private + hybrid flow

Open questions to resolve before next call
- Confirm actual token volumes and sequence length distribution (support vs embeddings)
- Confirm whether KYC docs require on-prem storage or if VPC-in-cloud meets compliance
- Who owns procurement for commit contracts? (legal/finance/ops)

Notes to self (rough)
- If they push hard on cost, start with dedicated-reserved + small pilot (8-16 GPUs) and show 30-40% ROI in first 60 days.
- Emphasize observability: token-level cost breakdown often convinces fintech ops teams.

Draft subject lines to test (A/B)
- "Reduce per-token cost for FinLedger - 20-min?"
- "FinLedger: predictable LLM latency + private deployments"
- "38% cost savings for payments teams - short chat?"

Quick templates for AE handoff (internal)
- TL;DR for AE: FinLedger (Series B fintech) exploring inference vendor for support summarization + KYC automations. Needs private/VPC, predictable latency, cost savings. Intro email to Priya Rao recommended.
- Attach: this note, preliminary TCO, suggested benchmark prompts (support 6-8 prompts + 20 embedding queries).

End of scratch notes - will refine before sending official outreach.
